label: Helenental Phone Beta
eyebrow: Private regional prototype · three connected cards
summary: Start at Engelstein, take the owner-defined right-side journey to Jammerwandl, or take the left-side journey toward Siegenfelder Steinbruch. Each card opens the same five-module PWA structure.

nodes.label: Engelstein
nodes.relationship: Owner-defined central point for this phone beta. Jammerwandl is the right-side branch; Steinbruch is the left-side branch.

media.label: Approved central Engelstein reveal
media.note: PRIVATE BETA — owner-approved DJI_0275 frames 14–100. The derivative and seekability are locally verified; rights, access, safety and public release remain separate gates.

nodes.label: Jammerwandl
nodes.relationship: Right-side journey from Engelstein toward Jammerwandl, Vienna and the beginning of Helenental, then back toward Engelstein.

media.label: Approved Engelstein-to-Jammerwandl-and-back journey
media.note: PRIVATE BETA — DJI_0363 from 00:50 to end, followed by the complete DJI_0364 clip in reverse. The sequence is owner-approved; separate flight identity, rights and public release remain gated.

nodes.label: Siegenfelder Steinbruch
nodes.relationship: Left-side journey from Engelstein toward Badener Kletterschule and Siegenfelder Steinbruch; route and topo discrepancies remain visible review items.

media.label: Approved Engelstein-to-Steinbruch journey
media.note: PRIVATE BETA — DJI_0365 followed by DJI_0195 with the final seven seconds removed. DJI_0158 remains excluded; route identity, rights and public release remain gated.
